content: विश्रब्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} (also written विस्रब्ध) .²1 Confided in, confided to, entrusted. .²2 Confident, fearless, confiding; सुविश्रब्धैरङ्गैः पथिषु विषमेष्वप्यचलता <ls>Mu. 3. 3</ls>; <ls>Mb. 3. 189. 47</ls>. .²3 Trusty, confidential. .²4 Quiet, calm, tranquil, free from anxiety. .²5 Firm, steady. .²6 Meek, lowly. .²7 Excessive, exceeding. .{@-ब्धम्@} {%ind.%} Confidently, fearlessly, without reserve, fear, or hesitation; विश्रब्धं क्रियतां वराहततिभिर्मुस्ताक्षतिः पल्बले <ls>Ś. 2. 6</ls>; वृषल विश्रब्धं पृच्छ, ममापि बह्वाख्येयमत्र <ls>Mu. 3</ls>.
